description: Checks a SWIFT/BIC code (8 or 11 characters): the format, bank code, country and its name, location, test and passive flags, branch, and the institution's LEI, legal name and address from GLEIF when a record carries that BIC. Without a GLEIF match the answer still gives the format check and institution null, with the reason. Pure code plus one GLEIF call, cached a day. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

bic.description: A SWIFT/BIC code, 8 or 11 characters, e.g. DEUTDEFF or DEUTDEFF500
